name: Small Business Pricing, Inventory & Profit Spreadsheet
title: Small Business Spreadsheet: Pricing Calculator, Inventory Tracker, Sales & Profit Dashboard
etsy_title: Small Business Spreadsheet, Product Pricing Calculator, Inventory Tracker, Etsy Fee & Profit, Sales Log, Dashboard, Excel Google Sheets
description:
Know what every product costs, what to charge after Etsy fees, what's in stock and what you really made: one simple sheet for any small shop.

WHAT YOU GET
• Materials library: cost per bead, ounce, yard or sheet worked out
• Product costing: up to 4 materials, packaging, your time, overheads
• Suggested price that hits YOUR margin after Etsy fees, plus wholesale
• Type your own price: profit, margin, profit per hour, price check
• Inventory: stock in, sold, on hand, low-stock and reorder flags
• Sales by channel with fees, expenses, dashboard with monthly chart

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Settings (rates, margin, channel fees), Materials (150 rows), Product Pricing (100 products), Stock In (400 rows), Sales (1,500 rows), Expenses (300 rows), Inventory.

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file. Prices and fee rates in the examples are illustrations: type in your own.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.

Questions? Send us a message, we're happy to help.
